xnodeMigration.title: Migration
xnodeMigration.actionFailed: The migration action could not be completed. Check the node status and retry.
xnodeMigration.continuity: Purchases keep access to legacy and migrated hosts. Legacy traffic continues syncing into the same allowance. Migrate one node at a time while other nodes remain available.
xnodeMigration.recoveryPending: Recovery needs attention. Resume rollback before another handover.
xnodeMigration.signedAgent: Handover requires an enrolled, compatible signed agent and successful server/client configuration checks. Failed handovers attempt rollback; accounting stays pending until the source is verified as settled.

issues.UNMATCHED_IDENTITY: Account does not match a linked panel identity.
issues.UNSUPPORTED_SHADOWSOCKS: Change this Shadowsocks inbound to an allowed method before handover.
issues.INCOMPLETE_TRAFFIC_HISTORY: The source node series does not reconcile with daily traffic totals.
issues.CLIENT_TEMPLATE_REQUIRES_CONVERSION: Convert the legacy client template before handing over this host.

xnodeMigration.finalHint: After every source node is disabled, export complete source history and reconcile linked accounts. Finalize only after reviewing the export. A changed source counter requires a new export. Finalization ends the legacy provisioning bridge.
xnodeMigration.completed: Migration finalized. Provisioning uses X-Node; source credentials and traffic history remain archived.
